note: Parameters locked at CC-007b recalibration. Used by E2 and E3 simulations.

M_SIGMA.description: vol margin coefficient (Paper 1 §C, Eq. C-1): scalar on σ̂ term

M_JUMP.description: jump margin coefficient (Paper 1 §C, Eq. C-1): 1.5× jump-prob·φ

KAPPA_BOOK.description: book-thinness coefficient (Paper 1 §C): 0.1% per unit thin depth

C_BOUNDARY.description: boundary correction funding rate per hour (Paper 1 §7, §C)

DELTA_R.description: resolution zone half-width in seconds (Paper 1 §7): 1 h

DEPTH_EPS.description: depth floor to avoid division by zero in KAPPA_BOOK term

MAINT_FRAC.description: maintenance margin fraction (Paper 1 §C): 50% of initial margin

SIGMA_CB.description: circuit-breaker vol multiplier (Paper 1 §7, R3 M_3 stage)

NOTIONAL.description: fixed position notional in USDC for all simulations

mechanic_descriptions.R0: naive forced expiry — no resolution-zone rules
mechanic_descriptions.R1: leverage compression only — linear ramp from L to 1× over Δ_R
mechanic_descriptions.R2: R1 + boundary funding correction — extra C_BOUNDARY funding when |mid-0.5| > DELTA_BOUND
mechanic_descriptions.R3: full multi-stage halt — M_1/M_2/M_3 position-size taper + circuit-breaker on vol spike

engine_descriptions.E0: baseline engine — constant volatility estimate, no dynamic margin
engine_descriptions.E1: EMA vol engine — exponential moving average vol, dynamic margin (no index scaling)
engine_descriptions.E2: recalibrated E1 — M_SIGMA·σ̂ + M_JUMP·p_jump·φ + KAPPA_BOOK/depth (CC-007b: no ·index on vol term)
